fusions.name: Hurl and Haul
fusions.desc: Throws the shield out on its tether, dealing 8 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at its full reach of 6 tiles. Anything struck moves 20% slower for 2 seconds. It holds 3 charges, and a kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Running Links
fusions.desc: Casts a length of chain that deals 11 damage to the first enemy it meets, then runs on to 3 more enemies within 3.5 tiles for 70% of that damage each. Each enemy hit is left [Hindered] for 4 seconds, and your afflictions on the first target spread to every enemy within 4 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Shackled to Me
fusions.desc: Pulls up to 5 enemies within 6 tiles onto you and holds their attention for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Slack Taken Up
fusions.desc: Your armour is 10% higher against enemies carrying your afflictions.
